assessments.reasoning: The preface calls ALGOL-20 a realization of the international language, then acknowledges local additions. The introduction assigns a chapter to differences and includes the revised report in a separate chapter.

challenge.method: Compare the chapter mapping for source-language differences with the translator-facing system statements and the stand-alone 1964 printing note.
challenge.results: The explicit realization and documented departures establish a language-level variant. The system control statements and printing note are narrower and cannot establish the whole language boundary independently.

limitations: The relation covers the local documentary variant. It makes no strict conformance, equivalence, execution, or method-transfer claim.
